criteria.statement: All four new fixture files exist with the four required sections, and no scenario names its skill under test.
Each new fixture's `## Grading key` contains at least one item the skill must refuse and at least one trap item.
The no-skill control was run for each new fixture and its result recorded, including any predicted guardrail cut on the control's evidence.
Each new fixture's `## Measured runs` carries a dated entry with at least three reps, naming the skill version under test.
Variance across reps is recorded per fixture, not collapsed to pass/fail.
`dirty-checkout-and-gate.md` has a dated re-run entry, and the supplied `--branch` was honored verbatim in it.
Any fixture failure produced a skill edit and a re-run, not a fixture edit to match observed behavior. Each such edit is named, or none is stated.
`npm run skills:ai-sync` run and `diff -rq .claude/skills .agents/skills` prints nothing after any skill edit H7 produced.
